scenes.name: 03-browse
scenes.caption: Create separate borrowing positions from one wallet. Start with WETH collateral and USDC debt.

scenes.name: 04-filter
scenes.caption: Filter between V3 and V4. The comparison and rate history follow the selected assets.

scenes.name: 05-select
scenes.caption: Select a V4 market. Its displayed base APY excludes the position’s collateral risk premium.

scenes.name: 06-review
scenes.caption: Review collateral, debt, estimated health factor and the exact market before signing.

scenes.name: 07-create-a
scenes.caption: The test wallet approves the tokens and creates the account through the local factory.

scenes.name: 08-second
scenes.caption: Same wallet, same V4 market. A new position gets a different account and its own debt.

scenes.name: 09-create-b
scenes.caption: Create the second account in the same market. Each position has a distinct on-chain address.

scenes.name: 10-portfolio
scenes.caption: Two accounts, one owner. Each row has its own collateral, debt and health factor.

scenes.name: 11-manage
scenes.caption: Add a second collateral asset to Position A. Preview the change in its own health factor.

scenes.name: 12-add-confirmed
scenes.caption: Confirm the local transaction. WETH and wstETH now back the same account.

scenes.name: 13-repay
scenes.caption: Repay 100 USDC on Position A. Position B’s principal stays separate.

scenes.name: 14-repay-confirmed
scenes.caption: The repayment is confirmed and the app refreshes this account’s native balances.

scenes.name: 15-final-portfolio
scenes.caption: Position A now has two collaterals and ≈400 USDC debt. Position B keeps its separate ≈250 USDC loan.
